title: Dotmod V1 dotAIO 2ml Kit
description:
Dotmod V1 dotAIO 2ml Kit
The DotMod DotAIO vape kit is a high-end device recommended for users of all experience levels. Featuring a compact and sleek design it is powered by a single 18650 vape battery (sold separately). This kit will hold up to 2ml of e-liquid and can be used to produce small or large amounts of vapour, to suit your style.
Brand
:
Dotmod
Product Type
: Aio Kit
Note
: This product requires 1 x 18650 battery. Batteries are sold separately.
With the dotAIO mini’s easy to remove 2.0 ml tank, changing coils has never been easier. The ergonomic spring-loaded contact located under the tank section allows for easy tank removal.  The dotAIO offers the same four power settings from the dotAIO that are based on coil resistance (very soft, soft, medium, strong), designed to fit your preferences and deliver the best performance.  Featuring dry burn protection that cuts the current when the e-juice level is low, extending the life of your coils.  Supporting one 18650 battery, the dotAIO is designed for maximum battery life.
Dotmod dotAIO is Ultra-Customizable
Compatible with all dotAIO coils, dotAIO RBA’s and dotAIO tank.  Are you a fan of Aspire Nautilus coils?  You can use them too with the adapter we included.  Prefer a mouth-to-lung experience?  Pop on a MTL drip tip or any other 510 tip – it’s compatible!
Features:
Compact vape kit
Mouth to lung and direct to lung vaping
Minimalist design
Mesh and ceramic coils included
Compatible with Aspire Nautilus coils
Pair with high PG or high VG e-liquids
35W max output
Auto wattage adjustment
Packaging Includes:
1 x dotAIO
1 x 2.0 ml e-juice tank (PCTG)
1 x airflow control base
1 x chimney adapter for Aspire Nautilus coils
1 x tank plug
1 x silicone bumper replacement
1 x 0.3 ohm Coil
1 x Spare coil (0.7 or 1.6 Ohm)
2 x Drip tips (gold, ultem)
6 x O-rings
1 x Type-C Charging Cable
1 x Certificate of authenticity
